attempts.text:
**The window opens on a spine.** Columns 0 to 10, `ybjM` to `gstB`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 26% of calls. The model names 70 to 99% of them, fewest at column 2, `rcdA`, 70%.

**Then columns 16 to 19**, `gsiD` to `gsiA`, are [[glutathione transport]]. A second branch of 10 families runs through columns 36 to 45, in 15 to 26% of chromosomes, all shell.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 94 against 90%, and hesitates less there, 0.38 against 0.44 bits. Its most hesitant column, 11, `yliI`, is a variable column, at 1.29 bits.

**The window ends in variable columns.** Columns 54 to 78, `cecR` to `ybhC`, are carried by 26 to 70% of chromosomes. The last column is `ybhJ`, in 21% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 92% of genes**, 0.42 bits on average, perplexity 1.5 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.46 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 73% against 96%.

label: ybjM
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the ybjM window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor ybjM, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,865 to 2,944 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying ybjM once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.42 bits on average (perplexity 1.5 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 33,453 calls, named 97%, 0.16 bits; shell 8,478 calls, named 80%, 0.98 bits; cloud 1,109 calls, named 17%, 3.97 bits. Outside an RGP 35,651 calls, named 96%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 7,389 calls, named 73%, 1.46 bits. Columns: 26 spine, 19 fork, 35 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.46 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (73% against 96%); 7,389 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 11 (yliI, a variable column) 1.29 bits, RGP 26%; column 2 (rcdA, a spine column) 1.05 bits, RGP 26%; column 33 (opgE, a variable column) 1.03 bits, RGP 23%. No column has most of its calls in an RGP.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 26 spine columns: named 94%, 0.38 bits on average; the 54 fork and variable columns: named 90%, 0.44 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 11, is a variable column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-10 (11 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-26%.
